en.content:
Design the flight route in detail on a map before using it for generation in Seedance 2.0

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
With Gemini Omni Flash, you can directly read the camera route drawn within an image and convert it into a realistic video❗️
For example,

- Maps
- Aerial photographs

By using these, you can create videos that seem to fly over tourist spots, which could be applied to tourism promotion or image video production😃

This time, I'll explain how to recreate this method in just four steps👇
